note: Upstream sources Weightsift builds against (decision 0014). Never forked, vendored or committed: native/fetch_upstream.py checks out exactly these files at exactly this commit into native/third_party/<name>/ (gitignored) and verifies their sha256 (of the repository's content: LF line endings). Change a pin only by editing this file, with the reason in the commit and the files' new hashes.

upstreams.name: colibri

upstreams.use: The expert-store lease contract (c/expert_store.h, c/tensor.h) that weightsift-colibri's shim implements over Weightsift's store; the engine-neutral layer-segment runtime (c/segment_runtime.h, .c) driven from Rust; its dependency-free conformance fixtures (tests only). None of Colibri's model engines is built here: they need gcc and POSIX headers.
